identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-12] Run opt-in soak and prove rollback

values.summary: Render and validate all six cards; freeze the reversible selector transaction, exact dependency gate, scenario manifest, evidence schema, protected paths, COTS, budgets, PVF, no-deferral, cutover, and rollback invariants; obtain bounded preparation review and fix findings; commit and push preparation only; wait for #5350 and #5361 terminal receipts and ancestry; then execute the complete exact-revision soak/rollback lifecycle without widening authority.

steps.action: Complete all six typed cards, design, Mermaid diagram, protected paths, COTS, budgets, PVF, no-deferral, selector rollback invariants, preparation validation, bounded review/fixes, durable commit, and push without execution
Maintain a read-only dependency watch and begin execution only when #5350 and #5361 satisfy live merge, typed closed_out, retained receipt, claim release, and ancestry gates
Implement the bounded manifest-driven soak and rollback harnesses without editing selector implementation, default state, Runtime v2, or dependency-owned code
Run every local, CI, Runtime v3, provider-disposition, demo, negative, rollback, evidence-integrity, budget, and no-deferral lane at the exact revision and fix all findings

Obtain exact-revision review, publish through typed v2, shepherd required checks, merge only under authorization, run post-merge proof, close out, retain the terminal receipt, release the claim, and hand accepted evidence to #5343

invariants: No execution begins before both dependency issues are live merged, typed closed_out, receipt-backed, claim-free, and ancestral
Only an isolated opt-in selector root may be mutated and the default selector is never changed by #5344
Every selector mutation uses the authoritative locked compare-and-swap interface; direct storage edits are forbidden
Prior selector bytes and digest are captured before mutation and restored exactly after every selected soak path
Every failure preserves prior bytes or enters explicit verified rollback; no implicit fallback is allowed
Rollback failure blocks #5343, WP-13 deletion, publication, and closeout
Evidence is deterministic, redacted, repo-relative, exact-revision bound, and claim-classified
Runtime v2 remains untouched rollback evidence and is never an edit or dependency target
All applicable acceptance and PVF lanes complete without deferral before publication
risks: A soak harness can accidentally become a second selector, workflow engine, or runtime supervisor
A test root can resolve to a production or default selector path and mutate operator state
Partial selector writes, stale expectations, interruption, or lock races can make rollback non-exact
Long-running scenarios can produce nondeterministic, machine-local, secret-bearing, or non-replayable evidence
Mock or credential-blocked provider evidence can be misrepresented as production readiness
A passing happy-path soak can hide failed-selection or failed-soak rollback defects
Child #5343 or WP-13 can begin from metadata instead of reviewed exact evidence
Harness and fixture growth can recreate maintenance burden unless LoC/module/time budgets remain enforced
stop_conditions: Any #5350 or #5361 live merge, typed closed_out, retained receipt, claim release, or ancestry predicate is absent or contradictory
Any intended protected path collides with an active typed claim
The authoritative selector cannot use an isolated root or requires direct storage editing
Exact prior selector bytes or digest cannot be retained and verified after rollback
A scenario requires AWS, raw credentials, hidden network, Runtime v2 edits, or production-state mutation
The scenario manifest, evidence, or claim classification is non-deterministic, secret-bearing, host-bound, or incomplete
Any acceptance or validation item would be deferred, skipped, or replaced with metadata-only proof
A LoC, module, test, dependency, or duration budget exceeds its limit without exact reviewed variance
